data.one_liner: Pure Dart collection of Nepali utilities including Bikram Sambat date conversion and formatting.
data.what_it_does: Provides utility classes for Bikram Sambat (BS) date-time operations, AD/BS date conversion, date and number formatting, fuzzy time moments, and Roman to Nepali Unicode text conversion.
use_when: You need to work with Bikram Sambat (BS) calendar dates in a Dart or Flutter application.
You need to convert dates between Gregorian (AD) and Bikram Sambat (BS).
You need to format numbers, currency, and timestamps into Nepali representations or words.
avoid_when: You only need standard Gregorian calendar utilities supported natively by Dart's core DateTime class.
strengths: Comprehensive collection of Nepali calendar and text utilities in a single package.
Supports date conversion and formatting across a wide range of BS years.
Includes live Nepali Unicode conversion for text inputs.
weaknesses: Limited to specific regional utilities (Nepal calendar, text, and numbers).
